newsitem.title: CHINA: Outokumpu starts up China copper pipe JV.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu starts up China copper pipe JV.

text.p: Finnish metals group Outokumpu Oy has opened a new copper pipe joint venture in China's southern province of Guangdong, a Chinese official said on Friday.
The venture in Zhongshan city would have annual production capacity of 10,000 tonnes of copper piping for air conditioners, an official with the Zhongshan Trade and Economic Office said by telephone.
Annual sales of the venture, which started up in November, was forecast at 329 million yuan ($39.6 million), the official said.
Exports would account for 80 percent of output, he said.
Outokumpu Oy has an 85 percent stake in the venture and hoped to expand operations in the future, the official said. He gave no further details.
